scope: Public Taiwan sources relevant to botanical display names, scientific names, materia-medica names, occurrence evidence and local-language aliases.

sources.title: 臺灣物種名錄 TaiCOL
sources.owner: 農業部林業及自然保育署支持之臺灣物種名錄
sources.caution: TaiBNET is the former name of TaiCOL and is not counted as a separate authority.

sources.title: 台灣植物資訊整合查詢系統 Plants of Taiwan
sources.owner: 國立臺灣大學生態學與演化生物學研究所
sources.caution: Cite the source; contact NTU before commercial bulk reuse.

sources.title: 臺灣中藥典第四版及修正公告
sources.owner: 衛生福利部中醫藥司
sources.caution: Apply later amendments as well as the base fourth-edition PDF.

sources.title: 處方中應使用之藥材名稱
sources.owner: 衛生福利部中醫藥司
sources.caution: A prescription material name is not automatically the botanical display name.

sources.title: 臺灣野生植物資料庫 TBD
sources.owner: 農業部生物多樣性研究所
sources.caution: Use for occurrence and cross-checking; do not silently override TaiCOL names.

sources.title: 台灣生物多樣性網絡 TBN
sources.owner: 農業部生物多樣性研究所
sources.caution: Observation evidence and accepted display-name authority are separate.

sources.title: Flora of Taiwan first and second editions
sources.owner: 臺灣植物誌編纂團隊／國立臺灣大學數位典藏
sources.caution: Historical taxonomy may differ from current TaiCOL acceptance.

sources.title: 臺灣大學植物標本館 TAI／NTUF
sources.owner: 國立臺灣大學
sources.caution: Specimen labels can preserve historical names; do not treat every label as current acceptance.

sources.title: 林業試驗所植物標本館 TAIF
sources.owner: 農業部林業試驗所
sources.caution: Use as specimen evidence, not the first display-name authority.

sources.title: 中央研究院植物標本館 HAST
sources.owner: 中央研究院生物多樣性研究博物館
sources.caution: Use as specimen and taxonomy evidence, not a direct replacement for TaiCOL.

sources.title: 國立自然科學博物館數位典藏標本
sources.owner: 國立自然科學博物館／政府資料開放平臺
sources.caution: Use for collection corroboration, not primary nomenclature.

sources.title: 臺灣中藥典圖鑑第二版
sources.owner: 衛生福利部
sources.caution: Image identification supports review but does not add facts to Köhler.

sources.title: 常用中藥材圖鑑
sources.owner: 行政院衛生署中醫藥委員會／衛生福利部
sources.caution: Older publication; current pharmacopeia and amendments win conflicts.

sources.title: 中藥彩色圖鑑
sources.owner: 衛生福利部
sources.caution: Use for identification review only.

sources.title: 臺灣原住民族藥用植物彙編
sources.owner: 衛生福利部中醫藥司
sources.caution: Traditional-use material is alias metadata only and is not modern medical advice.

sources.title: 農業部藥用植物主題館
sources.owner: 農業部農業知識入口網
sources.caution: Supplemental only; not a primary taxonomy or pharmacopeia authority.

sources.title: 教育部重編國語辭典修訂本
sources.owner: 教育部
sources.caution: Not a botanical taxonomy authority.

sources.title: 教育部臺灣台語常用詞辭典
sources.owner: 教育部
sources.caution: Alias only; preserve the linked scientific taxon.

sources.title: 教育部臺灣客語辭典
sources.owner: 教育部
sources.caution: Alias only; preserve the linked scientific taxon.

sources.title: 原住民族語言線上辭典
sources.owner: 財團法人原住民族語言研究發展基金會
